title: Audio (data/audio.json)
description: Named music tracks and sound effects (D138). Files lie under assets/audio/; a name with a missing file is a silent stub. A sound is a ZzFX recipe or a file; one named like a game event ("pickup", "hurt", "die"...) plays on that event.

music.description: Track id → track. Looping music; tracks are trimmed for seamless loops.

volume.description: Level of this track before the music slider (default 1).

sounds.description: Sound id → sound effect. A name "type:detail" ("cast:zap", "pickup:disk", "die:void") plays on that event when its spell, pickup kind or cause matches, else the plain "type" does (D139).

zzfx.description: ZzFX recipe: volume, randomness, frequency, attack, sustain, release, shape, shapeCurve, slide, deltaSlide, pitchJump, pitchJumpTime, repeatTime, noise, modulation, bitCrush, delay, sustainVolume, decay, tremolo, filter. null takes the default.

loop.description: A ZzFX recipe that repeats seamlessly while the game keeps it on (AudioEngine.setLoop, e.g. the shield's hum); make it a whole number of cycles.
